reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that locally audits agent tool calls, scores selected risks, reports operation history, and blocks specified irreversible commands.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地风险审计插件，可记录工具调用、评估风险、生成操作报告并拦截指定的不可逆命令。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that locally audits tool calls, evaluates selected risks, generates operation reports, and blocks specified irreversible commands.

capabilities: Records tool-call metadata, redacted arguments, outcomes, risk tags, and scores in local JSONL files
Applies deterministic risk scoring to selected destructive, credential-related, network, workspace, dependency, and build operations
Blocks specified irreversible filesystem, disk, protected-branch force-push, and credential-related network commands before execution
Provides session, turn, and history operation reports through the /risk-guard command
